_doc: Verified Vs supply decoupling for an INA240 current-sense amp (fires on ANY board that uses one — power meter, motor driver, charger, BMS...). Adds the datasheet-required 100nF local decoupling from the amp's V+ pin to GND, joining the anchor's EXISTING V+/GND rails (never a new rail, never a short). GENERAL mechanism: config only, any anchor part can get a verified block (config/verified_blocks/*.json), zero code. The shunt, the sense wiring, and OUT/REF stay with the architect — they live in the app-specific high-current power path, so V1 deliberately does NOT auto-inject them (additive-only completion can't do series insertion safely). Richer reference topologies (diff/CM input filter, multi-part blocks with namespaced internal nodes) are supported by the engine and proven in tests; author them per-part with datasheet review.
_real_pinout_note: INA240A1 KiCad pins: '+' (IN+, pin8), '-' (IN-, pin1), 'V+' (supply, pin6), 'GND' (pins 2/4), 'REF1'/'REF2', OUT is pin 5 with an EMPTY name -> referenced only by number, never wired here.

boundary_pins.role_hint: OUT -> MCU ADC (unnamed pin, by number)

skip_if._doc: No reliable proximity-based dedup for a rail decoupling cap (a shared rail already carries many caps), so V1 ships with no skip and relies on the default-OFF gate. A future refinement can dedup by placement proximity.
